3099-4565-4762-8320.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting three +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Ozolith, the Shattered Spire and Yoshimaru.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2511-3558-5006-8170.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.

Repeat.

1957-4050-5708--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Vein Ripper ability, gaining at least one life and causing at least one opponent to lose at least one life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

339-677-4785-6495.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

628-4247-7219.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing The Reaper.
When The Reaper dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Reaper enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

2178-4170-4871-8095.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
2178-4170-4871-8095.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Inkling.
When the Inkling dies, Fain and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Fain trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

7084-7892-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

3179-4399-4518-6720.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4518-6720.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

2919-3197-3263-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3197-3263-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1879-2034-5477-5660-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

687-2404-5411-6099.notablePrerequisites:
There are three removable counters among creatures you control excluding the first three +1/+1 counters on Mossborn Hydra.

687-2404-5411-6099.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Gaea's Cradle from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Gaea's Cradle enters, Mossborn Hydra triggers, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
687-2404-5411-6099.notes: The prerequisite can be waived if Mossborn Hydra has six or more counters on it.

254-2034--5.description:

When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat from step 2

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1029-5268-7010.description:
Activate Gran-Gran by tapping it, adding {1}.
Gran-Gran triggers, causing you to loot.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to untap Gran-Gran.
Repeat.

Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Karmic Guide
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide dies, Saffi triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

attached to any creature you control except Sekki

When Sekki dies, One with the Kami triggers, creating at least eight 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Sekki by sacrificing eight Spirits, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

You control at least one Cleric.

1894-4446-5220-6900.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

Animate Astral Cornucopia using Toymaker.

Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat from step 2.

1753-4251-6911.description:
Declare Godo as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Godo, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Godo that isn't legendary.
When the Godo token enters, it triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment and put it onto the battlefield.
During your next combat phase, declare Godo and the Godo token as attackers.
The Godo token triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

4853-5226-6810.description:

Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the Thopter.
When the Thopter dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Detective's Satchel.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

2034-2308-3641.description:
Gain any amount of life.

When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Distinguished Conjurer trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-6092-6466.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-6092-6466.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Shocking Sharpshooter triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

650-710-997.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

Cast Astrid by paying {1}{W}.
When Astrid enters the battlefield, its first ability and Samwise Gamgee trigger.
Resolve the Astrid trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Samwise Gamgee trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Astrid, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Samwise Gamgee by sacrificing three Foods, returning Astrid from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

722-1603-3153.notablePrerequisites: Evil Twin is a copy of Sphinx of the Second Sun.
722-1603-3153.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, both copies of Sphinx of the Second Sun trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

792-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Totentanz, adding {C}{C}.
When Totentanz dies, it and Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Totentanz from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Hope Tender's second ability by paying {1}, tapping and exerting it, untapping Hope Tender and Circle of Dreams Druid.

Cast Infectious Bite by paying {1}{G}.
Storm King's Thunder triggers, copying Infectious Bite nine times.
Resolve each Infectious Bite, causing each opponent to get ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

1283-1765-2034-2232.notablePrerequisites:
You have an Aura card in hand with mana value one or less.
You control an Aura with mana value one or less.
You have enough mana available to cast the Aura in hand.
1283-1765-2034-2232.description:
Cast an Aura with mana value one or less by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature you control.
The Aura enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Chishiro.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return any other Aura with mana value one or less from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chishiro trigger, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

475-2173-5078.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
475-2173-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

3957-4506-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Famished Paladin.
3957-4506-4702.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create a token copy of it with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Auriok Champion and gaining you 1 life.
All of your Famished Paladins trigger, untapping themselves.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens with haste.

2410-4702-5216.notablePrerequisites:
Iron Myr and Myr Galvanizer do not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Myr Galvanizer.
2410-4702-5216.description:
Activate Myr Galvanizer by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
Activate Iron Myr by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate the Myr Galvanizer token by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Repeat.

240-3914-4486.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to increase only Atla Palani's toughness by at least one.
240-3914-4486.description:
Increase Atla's toughness by at least one.
Activate Mirror Entity an arbitrarily large number of times by paying a total of {0}.
Resolve the first Mirror Entity ability, causing all creatures you control to have base power and toughness 0/0 and gain all creature types until end of turn.
All creatures you control except Atla die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
If Darksteel Colossus died this way, it shuffles itself into your library instead of being put into your graveyard.
Atla triggers once for each creature that died.
Resolve the first Atla trigger, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card, then putting the creature card onto the battlefield and all other revealed cards on the bottom of your library.
Repeat step 7 for each remaining Atla trigger.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Mirror Entity ability.
